# Make a contribution

Use this skill before creating issues, branches, commits, or pull requests for Caldova Careers.

## Before changing code

1. Read `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and any matching files under `.github/instructions/`.
2. Confirm the requested change belongs in this repository and not in external workshop content.
3. Keep the change focused on the issue or request.

## Commit guidance

Use a clear conventional commit prefix when practical, such as `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, or `chore:`. Include the Copilot co-author trailer unless the user explicitly asks not to.

```text
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
```

## Pull request guidance

Summarize what changed, list validation performed, and call out any follow-up work. Use the pull request template in `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` when opening a PR.

## Issue guidance

Use the issue templates in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` when filing bugs or feature requests. Keep acceptance criteria concrete and testable.
